description: Defines the LearningTaskControllerHelper class, which manages LabelledExamples during machine learning observations, including starting, updating, and completing examples, with integration for feature providers and callbacks.

classes.name: LearningTaskControllerHelper
classes.description: Helper class for managing incremental LabelledExamples during learning observations, handling their lifecycle and feature updates.

methods.name: BeginObservation
methods.description: Starts tracking a new example with given features and optional source ID.

methods.name: CompleteObservation
methods.description: Marks an example as complete and processes it.

methods.name: CancelObservation
methods.description: Cancels tracking of an ongoing example.

methods.name: pending_example_count_for_testing
methods.description: Returns the current number of pending examples for testing purposes.
